header.label: OpenAEC Foundation
header.title: Projects we support
header.desc: The OpenAEC ecosystem stands on the shoulders of open source. The projects below are an essential part of everything we build — which is why we support them and contribute back.

intro.p1: Open source is not a free raw material. Behind every framework, calculation library and standard our tools rely on are people and communities who maintain it. Without them there is no Open PDF Studio, no Open CAD Studio, no SuperCloud.
intro.p2: That is why a share of what OpenAEC receives flows back to the projects we build on — through donations, sponsorship and contributions in code. What we open up we do not keep to ourselves, and what we use we do not let wither.

give.title: Give back, not just take
give.desc: Whoever builds on open source should contribute to maintaining it.

sovereign.title: Safeguard sovereignty
sovereign.desc: Healthy upstream projects keep us independent of vendor lock-in.

standards.title: Open standards first
standards.desc: We invest in the open standards that move the whole sector forward.

buildingsmart.desc: The open IFC standard on which our entire model ecosystem (IFCX, IFC 4.3) rests. The basis for exchange without closed formats.

ifcopenshell.desc: The open toolkit that makes IFC files readable and editable across the whole open-source AEC world — including ours.

bonsai.desc: Native IFC authoring in Blender. One of the strongest proofs that full open BIM is possible — and an inspiration for our own work.

freecad.desc: The community's open parametric CAD foundation, the source of much of the expertise in our ecosystem.

tauri.desc: The lightweight, secure desktop runtime under nearly all our tools. One codebase for Windows, macOS, Linux — and the browser.

rust.desc: The memory-safe language our calculation cores are written in. Speed and reliability as a foundation.

solid.desc: The reactive UI framework behind Open PDF Studio among others — blazing fast and fine-grained.

pdf.desc: The open PDF rendering engines that put technical drawings and dossiers on screen instantly in Open PDF Studio.

wgpu.desc: GPU-accelerated rendering and UI in Rust — the foundation under the smooth 2D/3D display of Open CAD Studio.

whisper.desc: The open speech model that enables local, offline transcription in Open Speech Studio — no cloud, no subscription.

piper.desc: Fast, fully local text-to-speech with Dutch and English voices in Open Speech Studio.

nextcloud.desc: The open, self-hosted cloud foundation under OpenAEC SuperCloud — storage and collaboration without dependence on big tech.

note.text: Missing a project? This list grows with our ecosystem. Do you maintain an open-source project that is essential to the AEC sector and would you like to be considered for support? Let us know.

cta.title: Together we keep open source healthy
cta.desc: Are you a supporter or partner and want to help support these projects? Or do you build a project that belongs here? We'd love to hear from you.
